label: Main Room, The Spheres recording studio (Italy)
note: orchestral recording room with diffusors, wedge bass traps, an absorbent dropped ceiling and floating walls (paper); Neumann KH120 II loudspeaker (directional, facing the main microphones) at the first chair of each of 17 instrument sections (source), 22 session microphones (receiver): omni ambient pair and three omni mains, 17 cardioid section spots (in session 2 the Timpani and bass drum spots were wide cardioids; the paper does not say which session the RIRs come from). The paper's Fig. 9 gives T30 medians per microphone of 0.67-0.81 s (Main L 0.77 s, Main C 0.765 s); the main microphones here measure 0.77-0.79 s at the assumed 48 kHz, which supports that rate. Section spots far from the loudspeaker have only 35-63 dB peak-to-noise, so 144 of the 289 spot IRs have no rt_mid and the rest read 0.54-0.64 s.
